scope: Two fresh full multi-agent MCP runs; original five-case questions reused without changes. Manual comparison against returned source excerpts, not independent external audit.

notes: Annual financial figures match source records.
FX realized effects are separated from potential trade/economic risks.
Fed and CPI claims match evidence; no CPI percentage substitution.
New response does not use the previously mislabelled quarterly excerpt; saved-source regression separately confirms its nine-month heading.
Three-month and nine-month increases match consolidated table; annual decline and forward guidance are distinguished.
Opening wording about growth declining is imprecise: revenue declined while its annual contraction slowed; subsequent figures and interpretation are correct.

limitations: Two samples do not establish reliability across all companies.
Duration heading extraction preserves explicit English month headings; it is not a general semantic table parser.
Latency remains several minutes per complex question.
